Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1358
Claimant:
Adam Fowler
Adjuster:
Chelsea Hebert
December 13, 2024
First notice of loss received for a low-speed collision in a parking lot involving the insured's vehicle and a second
vehicle. The claimant reports neck and back strain and is not represented by counsel.
January 5, 2025
Confirmed the driver is named on the policy and that coverage was in force at the time of the loss. No issues with the
policy status were found.
January 15, 2025
Obtained the police report, which places the claimant inside the vehicle at the time of impact and notes the scene as
described.
February 24, 2025
Spoke with the other driver, who gave an account of the collision that matches what the claimant reported. Witness
statements were requested and are being collected.
March 1, 2025
Reviewed the photographs submitted by the claimant and the scene images. The vehicle damage is consistent with
the impact described and the reported injury fits the force of the crash.
March 7, 2025
Ran a prior claims and vehicle history search. No earlier damage to the vehicle is on record, and nothing suggests
the damage predates the policy start.
March 29, 2025
Called the claimant to take a recorded statement. The account given is the same as the one provided at first notice.
May 1, 2025
Requested medical records from the treating provider. The claimant reports ongoing neck and back pain and has
been attending regular physical therapy sessions.
June 18, 2025
Medical records show a small strain in the same area several years ago that healed fully, with no treatment since.
The claimant was asked about it and acknowledged the earlier episode.
July 14, 2025
Treatment has continued somewhat longer than is typical for a strain of this kind. Requested a treatment plan and
expected timeline from the provider to better understand the duration.
July 15, 2025
Reviewed the treatment plan with the medical reviewer, who noted the injury pattern is consistent with the collision.
Duration is bieng monitored against standard recovery guidelines.
July 18, 2025
Claimant has been contacted for an update on current symptoms and work status. File remains open pending receipt
of the updated treatment plan and witness statements.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
